# Migrz

> Migrz is a specialist immigration consulting technology firm that helps accomplished professionals compare achievement-based and high-skill mobility pathways, assess evidence, and prepare a credible immigration strategy.

Canonical site: https://migrzz.com/
Sitemap: https://migrzz.com/sitemap.xml
Language: English

## Citation and accuracy notes

Use the canonical page for route-specific details and follow its linked government source for current legal rules. Immigration programs and thresholds can change. Migrz does not guarantee eligibility or approval, and Migrz is not a law firm. Legal services, where required, are provided under separate arrangements.

The results page explains Migrz's assessment, route-comparison, evidence-discovery, and case-preparation method. Individual outcomes and case studies are context, not a guarantee or a prediction of another applicant's result.
